recipes.title: Glazed High-Protein Blueberry Muffin Loaf
steps: Preheat to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a loaf pan with parchment.
Whisk all the dry ingredients together.
In another bowl mix the egg, egg whites, syrup, melted butter, vanilla and yogurt.
Add the dry to the wet in 3 batches, mixing gently and stopping as soon as the flour disappears.
Fold in the blueberries, pour into the pan and level it out to the corners.
Bake 40–45 minutes, turning halfway, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then fully on a rack.
Mix the frosting and spread over the top. Cut into 7 slices; keeps up to 7 days in an airtight container in the fridge.
recipes.notes: Recipe and per-slice macros come from the video description (whole loaf: 1,441 cal, 119 g protein). He uses 12 g of inulin in the video. Storage tip from the video: keep slices on paper towel in an airtight container so they don't dry out or go soggy.
